commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' 6:2 – the corner kicks stats.
90+3' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

89' 4 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
87' Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
82' A substitution has been made. Inaki Williams is replaced by Adu Ares (Ath Bilbao).
79' Substitution. Oihan Sancet did his best and is replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
79' Here comes a substitution. Gorka Guruzeta is given a rest as he is replaced by Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao).
76' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Cyle Larin will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Daniel Rodriguez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
75' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) has tested the patience of referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
70' 60:40 – the ratio of ball possession.
68' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Iker Muniain (Ath Bilbao) replaces Nico Williams.
68' It's time for a substitution. Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) comes on in place of Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
62' Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) goes wild in celebration.
62' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
62' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.

62' Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
61' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner.
57' Javier Aguirre prepares a substitution. Antonio Sanchez is replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
57' Substitution. Nacho Vidal (Mallorca) in, Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud out.
55' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' What a sweet touch by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Predrag Rajkovic to hold.
54' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle as Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
53' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) will take the corner.
53' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
52' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
51' Let's have a look at the offside statistics – 0:5.
50' The linesman points to the corner flag, Ath Bilbao are going to take it.
50' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.

49' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle after Martin Valjent (Mallorca) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Ath Bilbao win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
47' The linesman raises his flag. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is adjudged offside.
47' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
46' The game has come to an end for Jose Copete. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
43' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
40' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
40' A long pass finds Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
40' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) releases Gorka Guruzeta with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
38' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
35' The Ath Bilbao players are stunned as referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
35' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Ath Bilbao as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
34' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Ath Bilbao! Great chance to score.
32' Predrag Rajkovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) after a cross from the side.
28' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
28' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
24' Ath Bilbao play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
22' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
21' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
19' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
18' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

16' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Gorka Guruzeta, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao), who beats Predrag Rajkovic with a brilliant shot into the top left corner. 2:0.
16' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ath Bilbao.
16' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
15' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
14' A cross into the box from Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
11' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
11' Jose Copete (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez stops the game and makes a call. Ath Bilbao have a free kick.
8' Mallorca are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
7' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) meets a cross inside the box, but Unai Simon wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mallorca, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

3' 1 - 0 It's the free kick. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a cross from Nico Williams and shows great technique to fire the ball into the back of the net. His effort from the edge of the box flies into the bottom right corner and changes the score to 1:0.
3' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Ath Bilbao.
1' The foul by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was seen by Jorge Figueroa Vazquez who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
